contactDescription: Use the contact below for service questions, access, correction, deletion, processing restrictions, withdrawal of consent or account closure. We may need to verify your identity.
loginNotice: On your first visit, we ask you to review the terms and consent to account data collection after your login provider verifies your identity.
publicContactWarning: This contact channel is public. Do not post your email, student number, travel information or other personal data. Ask for a private contact method first.
unknownVersion: The requested document version is not available.

privacy.collection: Google sign-in collects the provider, account identifier, email and verification status. Your Google profile name and photo URL are saved only with separate optional consent. Soongsil University SSO collects the provider, student number and name. We do not collect your provider password. Before consent, login information is temporarily processed in server memory to complete registration; pending registration is valid for 10 minutes.
privacy.cookies: Session cookies are valid for up to 30 days; temporary login and registration cookies for up to 10 minutes. Your recent login provider, display preferences and working itinerary data may be stored in your browser. You can delete storage or block cookies in browser settings, which may limit sign-in and saving features.
privacy.providers: Depending on the feature, we use Google's sign-in, maps, places and routing, Soongsil University SSO, Google Gemini or a connected OpenWebUI AI service, and Toss Payments. Feature-specific data, such as searches, coordinates, routing requests, AI messages, selected itineraries or payment requests, is sent to the relevant provider and may be processed on overseas servers. Enabling a share link exposes the itinerary to its recipients. Registration consent does not replace any separate consent required for advertising disclosures or international transfers.
privacy.purpose: We process information as needed for account identification, sign-in, requested itinerary storage, sharing, routing, AI responses, payments, abuse prevention, troubleshooting and service improvement. Required account-data consent is separate from optional profile consent. Declining the latter does not restrict basic service access. Registration does not include consent to marketing messages.
privacy.retention: Account information, optional profiles, saved itineraries and consent records are retained until account closure or withdrawal of consent is processed. Once their purpose ends, we delete them irrecoverably or make them non-identifying. Records legally required for retention, such as transaction records, are kept separately for the statutory period and not used for other purposes. Contact the team about deletion or retention.
privacy.rights: You may request access, correction, deletion, processing restrictions, withdrawal of optional consent or account closure. Withdrawing required account-data consent may end account service access. Withdrawing optional Google profile storage does not restrict basic service access. Account settings show your current accepted document versions and acceptance time.
privacy.security: Safeguards include account-based authorization, hashed session secrets and expiry of temporary external-login data. When a required document changes, we request review of the new version; we do not silently convert an old acceptance into consent to a new version.
privacy.serviceData: We process saved trip titles, places and coordinates, schedules, notes and sharing settings. AI features process your messages and selected itinerary data. Payments involve order IDs, amounts, status, payment keys and recurring billing keys. We also save service events, session identifiers, account IDs, timestamps and document-version consent records with server-recorded acceptance times. Do not enter sensitive personal information in itineraries or chats.

terms.account: Sign in with your own Google account or Soongsil University SSO and complete the required consent. Do not impersonate others, use another person's account, disrupt the service or access data without permission. Link only login accounts that you own.
terms.accuracy: Maps, opening hours, travel times, optimization results and AI responses may contain errors or become outdated. Check transport, opening status and booking conditions before visiting. This notice does not limit your legal rights or our legal responsibilities.
terms.changes: We publish notices when the service or terms change, and request review again when a required document version changes. You may stop using the service and request account closure or deletion at any time. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea, with disputes handled under applicable legal procedures.
terms.content: You retain rights to travel content you create. We process it as needed to provide the saving, sharing, routing and AI responses you request. When you enable a share link, anyone with that link may view the itinerary. Avoid including private information.
terms.payment: Review the checkout for prices, token allowances, payment methods and recurring payment terms. Contact the team about cancellation, payment errors or refunds. Rights provided by applicable law continue to apply.
terms.service: Trasolve helps you plan, save and share travel places, itineraries and routes. You must be at least 14 years old. Registration for children under 14 and guardian consent procedures are not currently supported.
